name: Amangiri
description: Carved into the desert plateau of southern Utah, Amangiri is architectural reverence in stone. Forty-five suites face the sandstone monoliths. Pools are cut from rock. Silence is the amenity. Guests come to disappear and reorient.
shortDescription: The desert as cathedral. Architectural minimalism meets monumental landscape.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter to Monument Valley
signatureExperiences.description: Private helicopter charter at golden hour. Land at restricted overlooks. Champagne service.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Slot Canyon Excursion
signatureExperiences.description: Antelope Canyon to yourselves before the public arrives. Photographer included.

signatureExperiences.name: Navajo Storyteller Dinner
signatureExperiences.description: Private fire dinner with a tribal elder. Stories under the desert sky.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Astronomer Stargazing
signatureExperiences.description: Observatory-grade telescope with personal astronomer. Champagne and small plates.

name: The Brando
description: Marlon Brando's private atoll, now a 35-villa carbon-neutral resort. Each villa has its own beach access, private pool, and unobstructed lagoon views. Bring nothing. Want for nothing. Leave changed.
shortDescription: Marlon Brando's island. Carbon neutral. Lagoon-fronted villas.

signatureExperiences.name: Lagoon Sunset Yacht Charter
signatureExperiences.description: Private catamaran with chef. Sunset sail across the atoll. Anchored dinner.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter to Moorea
signatureExperiences.description: Day trip via private helicopter to Moorea. Lunch at Sofitel beach club.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Motu Picnic
signatureExperiences.description: Helicopter to your own private motu (small island) for the day. Personal staff.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Marine Biologist Dive
signatureExperiences.description: Resident marine biologist guides you through the lagoon's coral nurseries.

name: Aman Venice
description: Sixteenth-century palazzo on the Grand Canal. Tiepolo ceilings. Twenty-four suites. Rooftop garden over Venice. Where you stay when you want Venice to feel like it once did.
shortDescription: Tiepolo-ceilinged palazzo on the Grand Canal. Twenty-four suites only.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Palazzo Dinner
signatureExperiences.description: Closed-museum dinner at Ca' Rezzonico. Quartet, candles, Venetian feast.

signatureExperiences.name: Gondola Dawn Tour
signatureExperiences.description: Private gondola through quiet morning canals. Cappuccino at a closed cafe opened just for you.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Murano Glassmaker Session
signatureExperiences.description: Private workshop with master glassmaker. Create a piece. Ship home.

signatureExperiences.name: Aperitivo on Private Yacht
signatureExperiences.description: Sunset spritzes on private vintage motoscafo through the lagoon.

name: Aman Tokyo
description: Top six floors of the Otemachi Tower. Views across to Mt. Fuji on clear days. Onsen-style spa. Tokyo distilled to its most refined essence.
shortDescription: Top of Otemachi Tower. Onsen spa. Tokyo at its quietest.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Sushi Omakase
signatureExperiences.description: After-hours at three-Michelin sushi master's counter. Twenty courses. No phones.

signatureExperiences.name: Imperial Palace Private Tour
signatureExperiences.description: Restricted access tour of Imperial Palace gardens with palace historian.

signatureExperiences.name: Bespoke Tailoring Day
signatureExperiences.description: Master tailor visits suite. Three garments commissioned, shipped home.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Tea Master Ceremony
signatureExperiences.description: Centuries-old tea ceremony at private temple. Just you.

name: Aman Kyoto
description: Hidden in a forested garden at the foot of Mount Hidari Daimonji. Pavilions among ancient cedars. Eight-acre secret garden. The opposite of speed.
shortDescription: Hidden forest pavilions in a centuries-old Kyoto garden.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Geisha Evening
signatureExperiences.description: Closed teahouse in Gion. Maiko and geiko entertainment. Kaiseki dinner.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Monastery Meditation Retreat
signatureExperiences.description: Day at active Zen monastery with abbot. Meditation, calligraphy, vegetarian lunch.

signatureExperiences.name: Kintsugi Master Workshop
signatureExperiences.description: Master shows you the art of golden joinery. Repair a piece you bring or one provided.

name: Aman Tangier
description: Hillside above the Strait of Gibraltar where Africa meets Europe by sight. Old World drama, North African material restraint, twentieth-century literary ghosts.
shortDescription: Hillside above the Strait. Where Bowles, Burroughs, and the Beats lived.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Medina with Historian
signatureExperiences.description: Closed-shop tour of Tangier medina with cultural historian. Mint tea in hidden riads.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter to Chefchaouen
signatureExperiences.description: Day trip to the blue city via helicopter. Lunch at private guesthouse.

signatureExperiences.name: Strait of Gibraltar Yacht Day
signatureExperiences.description: Private yacht to Spain and back. Lunch in Tarifa.

name: El Fenn
description: Restored medina riad complex by Vanessa Branson. Twenty-eight unique suites across former merchant houses. Rooftop bar with Atlas Mountain views. Quietly the best in Marrakech.
shortDescription: Vanessa Branson's medina labyrinth. The cool one.

signatureExperiences.name: Atlas Mountains Private Day
signatureExperiences.description: 4x4 to remote Berber village. Lunch with local family. Hammam back at riad.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Shopper through the Souk
signatureExperiences.description: Insider with relationships at every important vendor. Pieces shipped home.

signatureExperiences.name: After-Hours YSL Museum
signatureExperiences.description: Private after-hours visit with curator. Champagne in Majorelle Garden after.

name: Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc
description: Cap d'Antibes since 1870. The cabanas, the saltwater pool carved into rock, the gardens, the legend. Where Cannes Film Festival actually happens, in private.
shortDescription: The Cap d'Antibes original. Where the legend lives.

signatureExperiences.name: Day Yacht to Corsica
signatureExperiences.description: Private superyacht charter to Corsican coves. Crew, chef, swim platform.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter to Monaco
signatureExperiences.description: GP weekend or otherwise. Pit access arranged separately.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Cabana Reservation
signatureExperiences.description: Same cabana every day of stay, butler-staffed. Lunch service in cabana.

name: Hotel Il Pellicano
nearestAirport: Pisa / by car to Tuscany coast
description: Tuscan coast cliff-cling since 1965. Slim Aarons photographs were taken here. Still feels like that. The pool deck is the world.
shortDescription: Slim Aarons's Italy. Still exists. Still magic.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Boat to Giglio
signatureExperiences.description: Vintage motoscafo to Giglio Island. Lunch on the boat.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Vineyard Day
signatureExperiences.description: Helicopter to Brunello producer. Lunch and tasting at the family estate.

name: Il San Pietro di Positano
description: Carved into the cliff outside Positano. Private beach via elevator through the rock. Lemon groves, candles, terraces. The Amalfi Coast at its most operatic.
shortDescription: Amalfi cliff palace with private beach via cliff elevator.

signatureExperiences.name: Capri Day on Private Boat
signatureExperiences.description: Vintage gozzo to Capri. Lunch at Da Paolino. Blue Grotto when the crowd thins.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Cooking Class with Nonna
signatureExperiences.description: Local nonna teaches you Positanese classics in your suite kitchen.

name: Claridge's
description: Mayfair's grande dame since 1856. Art Deco bones, modern grace. Where royalty stays. Where Beaton photographed. Where you stay when London demands its full ceremonial weight.
shortDescription: Mayfair grande dame. Royalty's hotel.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Bond Street Shopper
signatureExperiences.description: Personal shopper opens doors at major houses after-hours. No press, no crowds.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Foyer Afternoon Tea
signatureExperiences.description: Closed Foyer. Pianist. Just your party. Champagne service.

signatureExperiences.name: Private V&A or British Museum Visit
signatureExperiences.description: After-hours curator-led tour of restricted collections.

name: The Newt in Somerset
description: Country estate hotel in Somerset. Heritage gardens, private cyder works, Roman villa onsite, deer park. England as it imagines itself.
shortDescription: Somerset estate. Cyder, deer park, restored gardens, Roman ruins.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Pheasant Shoot
signatureExperiences.description: Estate shoot with gamekeepers. Country lunch in shooting hut after.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Garden Tour with Head Gardener
signatureExperiences.description: Behind-the-scenes garden tour. Cuttings to take home.

name: Cliveden House
description: Astor family estate above the Thames. Three centuries of scandal, statesmanship, and immaculately maintained gardens. The Profumo affair started here. Now you stay here.
shortDescription: Astor estate above the Thames. Centuries of scandal preserved in amber.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Thames Boat Day
signatureExperiences.description: Vintage launch up the Thames. Picnic lunch on board.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Library Dinner
signatureExperiences.description: Astor's library, candlelit. Multi-course tasting menu. Just your party.

name: Six Senses Bhutan
description: Five lodges across Bhutan's western valleys. Each a different elevation, climate, story. Move between them on a 7-14 day journey. Buddhist monks bless your arrival. The opposite of striving.
shortDescription: Five lodges across Bhutan. Move between them. Be transformed.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Tiger's Nest Pilgrimage
signatureExperiences.description: Predawn ascent to Paro Taktsang. Monk blessing at the top.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Helicopter Across Valleys
signatureExperiences.description: See all five lodges from the air. Land at remote monastery for lunch.

signatureExperiences.name: Multi-Day Meditation with Monk
signatureExperiences.description: Personal meditation instruction with senior monk. Three days of guided practice.

name: Six Senses Zighy Bay
description: Hidden bay on Oman's Musandam Peninsula. Only accessible by 4x4, boat, or paragliding arrival. Stone villas with private pools facing the sea. Total disappearance.
shortDescription: Oman's hidden bay. Arrive by paraglider if you wish.

signatureExperiences.name: Paraglide Arrival
signatureExperiences.description: Tandem paraglide from mountaintop into resort beach. The legendary entrance.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Dhow through Musandam Fjords
signatureExperiences.description: Traditional dhow through the 'Norway of Arabia'. Snorkeling. Beach lunch.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Desert Camp
signatureExperiences.description: Overnight in luxury desert camp. Falconer demonstration. Stars.

name: Amanruya
description: Aegean cliff above a private cove. Stone cottages with private pools and sea views. Olive groves. The understated Aman approach to the Mediterranean.
shortDescription: Aegean cliff cottages. Private cove. Olive groves.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Gulet Day Charter
signatureExperiences.description: Traditional Turkish gulet for the day. Cove hopping, lunch on board.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Ephesus Excursion
signatureExperiences.description: Helicopter to Ephesus. Closed-site archaeologist tour.

name: Burj Al Arab
description: Sail-shaped icon. Suite-only. Helipad. Gold leaf. Excessive in every dimension and unapologetic about it. Where the Gulf flexes.
shortDescription: The sail. Gold-leafed suites. Helipad arrival.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter Arrival via Helipad
signatureExperiences.description: Arrive on the iconic helipad. Tea on arrival.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Yacht around Palm Jumeirah
signatureExperiences.description: Sunset cruise around Palm Jumeirah. Champagne, canapes.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Desert Falconry Camp
signatureExperiences.description: 4x4 deep into desert. Falconer, oud player, traditional feast.

name: Jumeirah Al Qasr
description: Madinat Jumeirah complex's flagship. Arabian palace aesthetic. Private beach, abra waterways winding through the property, souk attached. The grown-up choice in Dubai.
shortDescription: Madinat Jumeirah flagship. Arabian palace. Abras and souks.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Souk Shopping Experience
signatureExperiences.description: Insider shopper through Madinat souk after hours.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Desert Glamping Night
signatureExperiences.description: Overnight in private desert camp with full butler service.

name: Singita Sweni Lodge
description: Six-suite lodge on the Sweni River in Kruger. Glass walls onto the bushveld. Big Five at your doorstep. Conservation-driven luxury.
shortDescription: Six suites on the Sweni River. Big Five. Glass walls.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Safari Vehicle for Stay
signatureExperiences.description: Dedicated vehicle, ranger, tracker. Set your own schedule.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Walking Safari with Master Tracker
signatureExperiences.description: On-foot bush experience with senior tracker. All five senses engaged.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter Safari Day
signatureExperiences.description: Aerial game viewing. Land for bush brunch. Visit remote conservation sites.

name: Ellerman House
description: Edwardian mansion above Bantry Bay. Private South African art collection (one of the country's finest). Wine cellar of national significance. Eleven suites only.
shortDescription: Above Bantry Bay. Museum-grade SA art. Eleven suites.

signatureExperiences.name: Helicopter Wine Tour Stellenbosch
signatureExperiences.description: Heli to top three estates. Tastings and lunch at private cellars.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Art Tour with Curator
signatureExperiences.description: Owner's collection tour with house curator. Champagne service.

name: Fasano Trancoso
description: Trancoso's quasi-secret beach hideaway. Bungalows in the jungle, infinity pool over the Atlantic. Brazilian high society's worst-kept secret.
shortDescription: Trancoso's hidden Fasano. Brazilian aristocracy's secret.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Quadricycle Beach Villages Tour
signatureExperiences.description: Beach villages day tour. Lunch at remote pousada.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Schooner Coastal Day
signatureExperiences.description: Sail to neighboring beach coves. Fresh seafood lunch on board.

name: Fasano Punta del Este
nearestAirport: Punta del Este Laguna del Sauce
description: Isay Weinfeld-designed bungalows in the dunes outside Punta. Brazilian South American sophistication. Where the Latin American art world summers.
shortDescription: Isay Weinfeld bungalows in Punta dunes. Latin elegance.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Polo Day at La Bagatelle
signatureExperiences.description: Match arranged. Lunch at estancia. Optional ride.

signatureExperiences.name: Carmelo Wineries Day
signatureExperiences.description: Helicopter to Garzón vineyards. Lunch with the winemaker.

name: Rosewood São Paulo
description: Jean Nouvel-designed tower in Bela Vista. 175 rooms, four restaurants, art collection of major Brazilian works. The new center of São Paulo society.
shortDescription: Jean Nouvel's tower. Brazilian art. New SP society HQ.

signatureExperiences.name: Private SP Art Gallery Day
signatureExperiences.description: Insider tour of top galleries (Mendes Wood, Fortes D'Aloia). Studio visits arranged.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Samba School Visit
signatureExperiences.description: Behind-the-scenes at top Carnaval samba school. Rehearsal access.

name: Halekulani
description: House Befitting Heaven. Waikiki since 1917. Refined Hawaiian luxury. Where Tama hosts. The home court advantage.
shortDescription: Tama's Honolulu home court. House Befitting Heaven.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Beachfront Luau
signatureExperiences.description: Closed luau experience for your party. Hawaiian musicians and dancers.

signatureExperiences.name: North Shore Helicopter Day
signatureExperiences.description: Helicopter to North Shore. Surf lesson with Olympic surfer arranged.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Lanai Omakase
signatureExperiences.description: Top sushi master visits your suite. Twelve-course omakase on private lanai.

name: Sensei Lānaʻi (formerly The Lodge at Kōʻele)
description: Larry Ellison bought the island. Then turned this into a wellness sanctuary. Adults only, deeply private, individualized programs. The richest people you've never heard of are usually here.
shortDescription: Larry Ellison's island wellness sanctuary. Adults only.

signatureExperiences.name: Personalized Wellness Sensei Program
signatureExperiences.description: Bespoke physical, nutritional, mental program designed for you over your stay.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Lanai Island Tour
signatureExperiences.description: 4x4 to remote beaches and Garden of the Gods. Private picnic at hidden cove.

name: Amanyara
description: Northwest tip of Providenciales, on a nature reserve. Pavilions in pine forest with reflecting pools. Private. Quiet. Aman discipline applied to Caribbean blue.
shortDescription: Aman in Turks and Caicos. Reflecting pools. Caribbean quiet.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Yacht to Iguana Island
signatureExperiences.description: Catamaran to nearby uninhabited island. Snorkel, lunch on board, swim with rock iguanas.

signatureExperiences.name: Local Conch Diving + Cooking
signatureExperiences.description: Free dive for conch with local fisherman. Cook with chef on the beach after.

name: Twin Farms
description: 300-acre Vermont estate. Twenty cottages and lodges. All-inclusive. Whatever you want, whenever. The American answer to a country estate.
shortDescription: Vermont's secret. 300 acres. All-inclusive Americana.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Fly Fishing Guide
signatureExperiences.description: Master fly fisher. Vermont rivers. Picnic lunch streamside.

signatureExperiences.name: Maple Sugaring Private Experience
signatureExperiences.description: Sugar shack to bottle. Take your own syrup home.

name: Soneva Fushi
description: Maldives original barefoot luxury island. Each villa with private pool, observatory access, slow design. Sustainability-focused. The blueprint everyone copies.
shortDescription: Maldives original. Barefoot. Observatory. Sustainable.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Yacht Overnight
signatureExperiences.description: Sleep on private yacht in remote atoll. Crew, chef, deserted beaches.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Manta Ray Encounter
signatureExperiences.description: Marine biologist guides snorkel with manta squadron in Hanifaru Bay (season).

name: The Upper House
description: Andre Fu-designed, Pacific Place. 117 suites, no front desk, deeply considered. The grown-up's Hong Kong choice.
shortDescription: Andre Fu's Hong Kong. No front desk. Considered everything.

signatureExperiences.name: Bespoke Tailoring Day
signatureExperiences.description: Master tailor visits suite. Three garments, shipped home.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Junk Boat Day
signatureExperiences.description: Restored junk through Hong Kong waters. Lunch on board. Beach stop.

name: Passalacqua
description: Eighteenth-century villa on Lake Como, opened as hotel in 2022. Twenty-four suites. Voted world's best hotel within a year. Frescoes restored, gardens magic, the lake just there.
shortDescription: Lake Como's new icon. Eighteenth-century villa. Twenty-four suites.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Vintage Riva Day
signatureExperiences.description: Vintage Riva motorboat for the day. Captain. Lunch at Bellagio.

signatureExperiences.name: Closed-Villa Tour with Curator
signatureExperiences.description: Behind-velvet-rope tour of frescoes and grounds. Aperitivo in private salon.

name: Borgo Egnazia
description: Recreated Pugliese village on the Adriatic. Limestone, courtyards, olive trees. Madonna got married here. Now you stay here.
shortDescription: Built-from-scratch Pugliese village. Madonna's wedding venue.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Trullo Country Day
signatureExperiences.description: Visit medieval trulli in Alberobello. Lunch at private masseria.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Pasta Master Class
signatureExperiences.description: Nonna teaches you orecchiette and Pugliese sauces.

name: Splendido, A Belmond Hotel
description: Above Portofino harbor, with the postcard view. Sixty-four rooms, gardens, infinity pool, helipad. Where the harbor regulars stay.
shortDescription: Above Portofino. The postcard view. Where the regulars stay.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Gozzo to Cinque Terre
signatureExperiences.description: Wooden boat captain takes you down the coast. Lunch in Vernazza.

signatureExperiences.name: Private San Fruttuoso Excursion
signatureExperiences.description: Boat to abbey accessible only by sea. Private monastery tour.

name: Explora Patagonia
description: Inside Torres del Paine National Park. Forty-nine rooms facing the towers. All-inclusive expeditions: trekking, riding, kayaking. Wilderness as the only program.
shortDescription: Torres del Paine. Forty-nine rooms. The towers as wallpaper.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Helicopter Glaciers Day
signatureExperiences.description: Land on glacier. Champagne on ice. Aerial tour of Southern Ice Field.

signatureExperiences.name: Multi-Day Private Horseback
signatureExperiences.description: Two-day ride to remote estancia. Sleep under stars. Gauchos as guides.

name: Rosewood London
description: Edwardian Belle Époque manor in Holborn. Marble grand staircase, courtyard, deeply considered service. The London hotel for people who don't want Mayfair.
shortDescription: Edwardian Holborn manor. The anti-Mayfair London choice.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Savile Row Tailoring Tour
signatureExperiences.description: Insider tour of three legendary tailors. Bespoke order at one of them.

signatureExperiences.name: Private After-Hours Tate Modern
signatureExperiences.description: Closed museum tour with senior curator. Champagne in the Turbine Hall.

name: Château de Fonscolombe
description: Eighteenth-century château outside Aix-en-Provence. Vineyards, lavender, library. Forty rooms. The Provence of imagination, made real.
shortDescription: Eighteenth-century Provence château. Lavender, vines, library.

signatureExperiences.name: Private Lavender Harvest Day
signatureExperiences.description: Help with harvest. Distillery tour. Take home essential oil bottle.

signatureExperiences.name: Cézanne Studio Private Visit
signatureExperiences.description: Closed visit to Cézanne's atelier in Aix. Curator-led.
